get_key_models: get the list of models accessible by a user API key from model access groups and proxy model list
get_team_models: get the list of models accessible by a team from team models and model access groups
get_complete_model_list: get the complete model list for a key and team pair including wildcard expansions and provider models
get_known_models_from_wildcard: expand a wildcard model pattern like openai/* into a list of known provider models
get_all_fallbacks: get all fallback model names for a given model from the router fallback configuration
